subject: general
question: The head office of National Bank for Agricultural and Rural Development is located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Bank for Agricultural and Rural Development (NABARD) is an apex development bank in India, established in 1982.**
 
• The head office of NABARD is located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• In India, the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) is the highest regulatory agency responsible for overseeing both apex cooperative banks and regional rural banks.
 
• The Indian Ministry of Finance is the only owner of it. The bank was given the task of handling "matters concerning policy, planning, and operations in the field of credit for agriculture and other economic activities in rural areas in India".
 
• Financial inclusion is being developed and implemented by NABARD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On July 12, 1982, Act 61, 1981 of Parliament was passed, implementing the B. Sivaramman Committee's recommendations and creating NABARD to carry out the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act of 1981.
 
• It took the position of the Reserve Bank of India's Agricultural Credit Department (ACD), Rural Planning and Credit Cell (RPCC), and Agricultural Refinance and Development Corporation (ARDC).
 
• One of the top agencies, offering 100% stake of Rs. 14080 crore. A share capital of Rs. 30,000 crore has been sanctioned.
